verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Make's core workflow unit, the scenario, with documented management (clone, schedule, history), data-transformation functions and error handlers, so multi-step workflow building is implied. No cited item describes a visual or drag-and-drop editor, or confirms that scenarios are built without writing code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual scenario editor, evidence of no-code module chaining and configuration, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
